 Korean War veterans — Students Record Testimony of 93-Year-Old Veteran
 Nov 11, 2026 10:17 PM PST Students from the Los Angeles Korean War Memorial Foundation’s youth history education program ‘Heritage Guardian’ visited the home of 93-year-old Marine Corps Staff Sergeant Alfonso Guba, a Korean War veteran in the Hesperia area, on the 7th to document his combat experiences as a documentary video. Guba and the students pose for a commemorative photo after the video recording. [Provided by Republic of Korea Army US Association] 
 Students participating in the ‘Heritage Guardian’ youth history education program by the Los Angeles Korean War Memorial Foundation visited the home of 93-year-old Marine Corps Staff Sergeant Alfonso Guba in Hesperia on the 7th to document his combat experiences in a documentary video.
